name: Yamakita (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yamakita town emblem in red: a stylised mountain peak between two curved horn-like strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Yamakita, a town in Kanagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 February 1959.

features.role: Yamakita town emblem — a stylised mountain peak between two curved horn-like strokes
